text.offer: The carters who bring my ale come in along the edge of the Forest of Farol, and they've stopped coming. Centipedes, they say, as long as a man. Clear the road for them, eight should do it, and you can thin the rats in the outskirts on the way. Come back for more whenever you like, until you're ready for the road to Marion.
text.progress: The road runs along the western edge of the Forest of Farol, past the outskirts of Raza, where the rats are.
text.complete: The carters will be glad to hear it, and so am I. Drink's on the house next time.
